reuse.why: The new action reuses category selection, amount conversion, sheet access, budget writes, batching, and undo registration.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules remain shared, although the includeHiddenCategories-to-hidden-mode mapping repeats across six actions.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget operations stay in actions.ts, while handler registration stays in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits cover the requested month-wide actions, supporting metadata, method registration, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The centralized predicate keeps exclusions consistent, though optional selection metadata and repeated hidden-mode mapping leave modest maintenance risks.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use shouldFillCategory directly or through getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated hidden-mode mapping is explicit; eligibility and amount-sign logic remain shared.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory gains template and fixed-group exclusion branches; its existing hiddenMode parameter handles the new option without additional helper parameters or bypasses.
